messages:
ana: Quick report: new quantized canary (raven-lite-int4) is emitting short human prefixes before JSON in ~3.4% of streamed outputs. Example: 'Ok here it is:
{"result": true}'.

ben: That will break strict funcalling. Any pattern on temps or prompt variants?

ana: Mostly low-temp completions and when we use a soft system prompt. Streaming seems more likely.

kevin: Proposed immediate mitigation: parser soft-strip that seeks first '{' or '[' and tries to parse from there, with schema validation. If repair applied, mark telemetry field repaired=true and archive raw output to audit bucket.

ben: Add streaming-specific glue: buffer until matching braces or token limit, rather than failing on first partial chunk.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for adaptive-json-rescue at 05:00 UTC. Link: https://deploys/reddo/1788123456-adaptive-json-rescue

ana: I'll run a short fuzz: 1k samples int4 vs fp16 to measure prefix rate and repair yield. Posting numbers here in ~2h.

kevin: Keep an eye on repaired_fraction and post_repair_schema_ok. If schema_ok < 99% we rollback.

ben: Also experiment with stronger system instruction 'RETURN ONLY JSON' to see if generation-side fix reduces repair need.
